name: Stormbringer: Nimbus resets Windsurf, Unshackle and Wind Gate: Evacuate natively (#3726)
contract: #3726: Nimbus 704212 has Effect[0]=Effect[1]=195 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (TargetA=1 CASTER, MiscValue 500042 / 706625, MiscValueB=1) and Effect[2]=187 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESTORE_SPELL_CHARGES (TargetA=1 CASTER, MiscValue=532, BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 -> 2). Effects 195 and 187 are stock core handlers (Spell::EffectAscensionResetCooldown, SpellEffects.cpp:541-550, calling ResetAscensionCooldown at :290-301 = RemoveSpellCooldown + RemoveCategoryCooldown; Spell::EffectAscensionRestoreSpellCharges, SpellEffects.cpp:552-562, calling Player::RestoreSpellChargeCategory, Player.cpp:17252-17265). Windsurf 500042 (RecoveryTime 90000) and Unshackle 706625 (RecoveryTime 120000, no category) are cleared by effect 195; Wind Gate: Evacuate 504643 is a charge ability with no cooldown of its own (RecoveryTime 0, Category 0) whose SpellCharges.dbc row keys ChargeCategoryId 532 with SpellChargesCategory max 2 / 60000 ms recharge (ApplyClientSpellCharges, AscensionClassMechanics.cpp:1034-1051), so effect 187's RestoreSpellChargeCategory(532, 2) is what "resets" it. The issue's premise ("zero occurrences of 704212 in source") is true of the spell id and irrelevant, since both effects are generic. No script, dummy or spell_proc wiring exists or is needed.
